To our Lord on the Water-made Wine

Richard Crashaw (c. 1613–1649)

J
OHN II.
 
1–11
.
T
HOU
 water turn’st to wine, fair friend of life;
Thy foe, to crosse the sweet arts of Thy reigne,
Distills from thence the teares of wrath and strife,
And so turnes wine to water back again.
